entry.title: WSK-build/DSHBox
entry.summary: DSHBox — Run DeepSeek Harness locally on Android phones and tablets. It integrates and coordinates DSH, PRoot, WebView, Debian and Node.js, together with a terminal, a file manager，a browser and other tools, into a personal AI workbench. No root access, and no separate Termux installation.
